topics.title: Anthropic's $2 Trillion IPO Push
topics.why: If Anthropic's October IPO lands anywhere near investors' $2 trillion target, it'd be the largest IPO in history -- a real signal of how much growth investors think is still ahead for AI.

topics.title: Google Hands Its Agent Protocol to a Neutral Foundation
topics.why: Google just moved its Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol under the same open foundation as MCP, a step toward AI agents from different vendors actually being able to talk to each other instead of staying siloed in one company's tools.

topics.title: A YC Startup's AI Worker-Surveillance Backlash
topics.why: Optifye.ai's demo of AI cameras tracking factory workers in real time went viral and drew fierce backlash this week -- a preview of the reckoning any company deploying AI monitoring tools should expect.
